g.text: Recursive decomposition - chunk lifecycle and depth decision (ADR-006)
Role d1 reads card inputs (grep/offset, not the corpus)
Write the artifact in one session
Write the chunk plan to docs/chunks/T-XXX.json
Brief, then spawn one same-role child (depth + 1)
Stop and broaden ownership or split the artifact
All chunks done -> checkpoint may close
- one child at a time, never parallel
- a stop is safe only at a chunk boundary
